purpose: Verify that the cooperative-driving candidates rest on executable public assets rather than paper-only claims.

checks: Sparse checkout of README.md, LICENSE, scenarioset, model_envs, and tools completed.
Found exactly 46 InterDrive, 112 Interaction, and 67 V2XPnP scenario leaf directories.
Parsed all 278 scenario JSON files with zero JSON errors.
Validated all 6603 active scenario XML files with xmllint and observed zero errors.
Confirmed runner entries for CoDriving, TCP, LMDrive, UniAD, VAD, CoLMDriver, and perception_swap_{fcooper,attfuse,disco,cobevt}.
Confirmed pose-error and communication-latency variants for cooperative perception swaps.
Confirmed per-tick prediction dumps plus ADE, FDE, AP, and predicted-collision metrics in tools/openloop_post_metrics.py.
reproducibilityRisks: CARLA 0.9.12 and planner-specific legacy Python/CUDA environments are required.
The four HEAL-backed perception_swap variants declare about 16 GB of GPU memory each in the runner's observed estimates.
The --openloop CLI help still describes legacy ego teleportation, while the current runtime branch deliberately keeps normal closed-loop ego control unless CUSTOM_EGO_LOG_REPLAY=1 is set.
Native AP visibility filters differ between CoDriving and perception_swap; the runner exposes --no-visibility-filter to make cross-pipeline AP comparable.
Model checkpoints are separate downloads and must be fingerprinted before any comparison.

assets.availability: public for academic or nonprofit research
checks: Shallow checkout completed and the corruption generator was inspected.
The generator exposes camera corruption functions and five severity levels over test data.
The README documents OPV2V-C, V2XSet-C, and DAIR-V2X-C plus positive and negative collaboration coefficients.
reproducibilityRisks: The generator imports imagecorruptions and a legacy Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.12, CUDA 11.6 stack; that environment was not installed during this audit.

The implementation list contains 13 explicit corruption names while the README describes 14 camera corruptions plus temporal misalignment; every selected condition must be enumerated in the experiment manifest.
The license prohibits redistribution and commercial use without separate permission.
Dataset paths and original benchmark downloads require local configuration.

assets.availability: public project, code, mini split, and full dataset links
checks: Official project and repository expose code and dataset licensing separately.
The project documents real C-V2X throughput, latency, packet loss, and jitter traces together with synchronized multi-agent sensors.
reproducibilityRisks: The mini split is about 2.9 GB and the full dataset about 94.3 GB; no full download was performed.
A real-log replication must remain separate from MDrive's reactive closed-loop claim.

checks: Parsed the official cooperative split manifest used by the repository audit.
Observed train=4813, val=1783, test=2688, and test_A=851 with unique IDs, no split overlap, and test_A contained in test.
reproducibilityRisks: The split manifest check does not validate sensor payload integrity or every annotation.
Published frame counts differ across some secondary descriptions; only the official split used by an experiment should be treated as authoritative.

sampleChecks.method: Count scenario leaf directories, parse every JSON file, and validate every active XML file.
sampleChecks.boundedScope: Repository metadata and route files only; no CARLA or model inference was run.

sampleChecks.method: Parse split JSON and test uniqueness, disjointness, and subset relations.
Inspect official generator, dependencies, corruption list, and license.
sampleChecks.boundedScope: No generated image was claimed because the required Python image stack was absent.

unverifiedItems: No candidate is allowed to claim a complete MDrive run before CARLA, checkpoints, and one planner-specific environment pass a smoke test on CUDA hardware.
No candidate is allowed to call V2XPnP playback a fully reactive real-world experiment.
No candidate is allowed to treat a repository software license as the dataset license.
CooperScene is an optional external-validity checkpoint, not a prerequisite for the bounded MDrive pilots.
